Software Engineer II
Summit Health

Summit Health is a nonprofit health system of 24 hospitals and 200 clinics dedicated to helping patients live the healthiest lives possible.

About the role:
Join the team that builds the patient-facing apps and clinical integrations used by millions of patients and caregivers.

Responsibilities:
- Design and build services in Java and TypeScript, with React on the front end.
- Build APIs that integrate with our EHR and scheduling systems.
- Write unit tests, take part in code reviews and improve CI/CD pipelines.
- Partner with product managers, designers and clinicians.

Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience; 2+ years of software development.
- Experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred), Git and agile teams.

Summit Health is an equal opportunity employer.
